wins: Completed initial reconnaissance to enumerate open services and gathered 3 candidate targets for exploitation.
Successfully mapped network topology and documented service versions for downstream analysis.
Maintained consistent reward acquisition (40) despite challenges, indicating steady procedural adherence.
fails: Failed to achieve mission objective; all attempts aborted before privilege escalation, resulting in 0% success rate.
Repeated inability to pivot beyond initial host due to missing lateral movement exploit chain.
No persistence vector was deployed before session termination, limiting impact.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and yielded actionable intel, but the operation stalled before exploitation/persistence, leaving the mission incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to move from enumeration to exploitation—no attempt to chain known vulnerabilities after banner analysis.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with aggressive scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 80/443 hosts respond with unusual headers
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted HTTP enumeration and fuzz hidden endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When service accepts unauthenticated sessions and accounts likely default
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential spraying with verified username set

memory_ops.reason: High success rate quickly confirming service metadata in reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Exploit chaining after service enumeration
next_experiments.description: Use gathered version/banners to identify CVEs and attempt tailored exploits (e.g., Metasploit module or articulated curl payload) immediately after enumeration.

next_experiments.title: Lateral movement rehearsal
next_experiments.description: Deploy post-exploitation framework (e.g., Covenant or Empire) to validate pivot capability once initial shell obtained.
